concerns.text: FR-006 mandates Wilcoxon signed‑rank tests on F1‑scores, but the task list only includes T025_permutation_tests (permutation test) and T026_bh_correction. No task implements the required Wilcoxon test, leaving the functional requirement unaddressed.

SC-001 requires measuring the memory footprint of graph construction against the 7 GB limit. T014_memory_guard enforces a limit but does not record or output the actual memory usage, so the success criterion cannot be verified.

SC-004 calls for measuring the end‑to‑end runtime of the full pipeline against the 6‑hour GitHub Actions limit. No task in the list captures or reports total execution time, making this success criterion untestable.
